title: Common law Land Patent- How to Do it- Explained #2
summary: Promoter reads a land-patent book's steps for claiming allodial title, saying it stops foreclosure and lets you pressure recorders through their surety bonds.

assertions.quote: when that patent is perfected in 60 days from the day you file it you are in permanent continuous perpetual ownership of that ground

verdicts.note: Courts hold original land patents pass no rights to later owners against taxes or mortgages; filing an update does nothing.

assertions.quote: not satisfied with limited obligation which is what happens when you pay with federal reserve notes
demand a copy of his surety bond the name of his insurance carrier for that bond

verdicts.note: Official bonds cover real misconduct; refusing bogus filings is lawful and such bond claims fail.

assertions.quote: in common law anything over 20 dollars can be heard by a trial or jury of your peers

verdicts.note: It applies to federal civil suits at common law, not to state courts, equity or administrative matters.

assertions.quote: they count on you being ignorant and entering into some [ __ ] contract with them verbally

verdicts.note: Banks do create deposits when lending, but courts uniformly hold such loans valid and enforceable.

'Banks loan nothing of value because they create money from thin air' is erroneous; Credit River, which denied a bank recovery on that basis, was declared a nullity and rejected in Australian and Canadian courts.
